run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system with a given checkpoint and inference settings
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy and force error metrics
format_report_table: format a dictionary of benchmark results into a human-readable table string
run_PerfCheckRunner: run a PerfCheckRunner benchmark that compares candidate inference settings against an fp64 baseline
load_baseline_cache: load cached baseline inference results from a JSON file if the cache key matches
